resources.name: VA Home Improvements and Structural Alterations (HISA)
resources.eligibility_summary: VA medical justification and benefit rules apply; service connection is not a universal requirement.

resources.application_or_referral_route: Use VA facility locator to reach local Prosthetics; county VSO can help navigate.
resources.next_step: Request medical review and the application checklist.
constraints: Medical prescription/approval, Form 10-0103, itemized estimate and photo; renters need notarized owner consent.

preserved_seed_fields.limits: Excludes routine repairs, new construction and listed portable equipment; not organizational development funding.
